Mistra Review: Why This Discus Thrower Loves Rush Wars
Mistra: The Discus Diva Who Punishes Speeding
Mistra is a 5-star Ice hero from the

family, originally released in May 2024. As a Slow mana speed hero in a game that increasingly favors speed, she occupies a specific niche: punishing enemies for being fast. Her kit is designed to turn the opponent's greatest strength—their mana speed—into their downfall. While she might not be the first pick for a standard raid defense in the current high-speed meta, she is an absolute menace in Rush Attack formats. Think of her as a traffic cop who hands out tickets (and massive damage) to anyone exceeding the speed limit.

Mistra is depicted mid-throw, winding up a magical discus that looks like it could decapitate a titan. The dynamic pose captures the athleticism of the Champions family theme perfectly. Her design features vibrant blues and purples, with a confident, almost cocky expression that suggests she knows exactly where that discus is landing. It's a refreshing, energetic design that stands out from the usual "grim warrior standing still" pose.

Family Bonus, Passives, Aether Power & Unique Abilities

The Champions family bonus gives a raw Attack boost (+35%/+50%/+65%). This is crucial for Mistra because of her low base attack. Pairing her with even one other Champion (like Satori or Lazara) makes a noticeable difference in her damage output.
Gaining +24% mana generation when receiving a status ailment is huge for a Slow hero. It punishes enemies who rely on DoT or debuffs to control the board.
Dealing 100 fixed damage to enemies when an Average or faster enemy fires is a nice bit of chip damage. It breaks minions and softens targets, but it's not a game-changer on its own.
She cannot get Attack Down. This guarantees her special always hits with full force, which is essential for a nuker.

Mistra is a specialized tool in a Swiss Army Knife game. She isn't the hero you take to every battle, but when the conditions are right (Rush Attack or a Very Fast enemy team), she is arguably one of the best in the business. While her stats have aged, her mechanics keep her dangerous.
Keep her, emblem her for Attack, and unleash her whenever the "Very Fast" rule is in play.
